paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
notes: Projection (sensitivity forecast) for vector B-L dark photon dark matter using a SiN membrane / Be mirror optomechanical accelerometer. Y-axis is g_B-L (dimensionless) vs mass 1e-12 to 1e-10 eV (Fig. 2). Paper also presents a B-coupled (baryon) projection (Fig. 4). Data points are approximate readings of the projected sensitivity envelope from Fig. 2; exact tabulated values are not provided so coordinates are estimated from the plotted curves. The strongest projected sensitivity reaches ~3e-24 near 10^-11 eV (~10 kHz).
